kyc.consent.body: Review and confirm the current identity verification and data-processing notice before submitting.
kyc.needs_info.body: More information is needed. Review the missing items and submit them within the stated time.
kyc.rejected.body: This verification was not approved. Review the visible reason and use the available resubmission or appeal path.
robot.restricted.body: This Robot feature is temporarily unavailable. Review the reason and the next available action.
robot.upgrade_confirm.body: Before upgrading, confirm the target level, APT cost, capability changes, cooldown and irreversible effects.
robot.reward_dynamic.body: Reward depends on eligibility, budget, standard capacity and the current dynamic coefficient. The coefficient can change and may be zero.
prediction.risk_disclosure.body: Prediction outcomes are uncertain and may also be affected by event conditions, participation requirements, result reviews, refunds or corrections. Confirm you understand before participating.
prediction.consent.body: Before submitting, confirm the match, direction, participation amount, rule version, and refund/correction rules.
prediction.low_liquidity.body: Current participation or other opening conditions have not been met. This Prediction may be paused, voided or refunded.
prediction.result_not_settlement.body: A match result does not mean settlement is complete. Use settlement status and ledger records as the final reference.
prediction.correction.body: If a result or settlement is corrected, the original record is preserved and the correction uses reversal and new records instead of overwriting history.
otc.submitted_not_completed.body: A submitted order is not a completed trade. Continue to check matching and settlement status.
otc.partial.body: For a partial fill, only the filled portion creates the related APT and Power effects. The unfilled portion remains frozen or is released under the rules.
otc.unknown_result.body: This is still being processed. Check the result later and do not submit it again.
otc.power_flow.body: A sell order freezes Power under the rules. Only the filled portion is consumed; the unfilled portion is released after cancellation or expiry as applicable.
apt.reference_valuation.body: APT reference valuation is an unrealized estimate based on a stated source and time. It is not cash income or a guaranteed redemption value.
mfa.security_notice.body: Secondary verification protects sensitive actions. After verification, the original request continues instead of creating a duplicate business action.
support.resolution.body: The resolution keeps links to the related object, handling record and next step. If you still disagree, use the available appeal path.
policy.region_restricted.body: This feature is currently unavailable for this region or channel. Availability depends on approved locations, channels and applicable requirements.
financial.no_guarantee.body: Historical data, Reward, reference valuations, market prices and liquidity do not guarantee fixed returns, principal protection, payback or execution.
